mapper.select: SELECT w.*, q.id as q_id, q.subject, q.type, q.content, q.option_a, q.option_b, q.option_c, q.option_d, q.answer, q.analysis, q.knowledge_point, q.difficulty FROM wrong_question w LEFT JOIN question q ON w.question_id = q.id WHERE w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question (user_id, question_id, user_answer, wrong_reason, mastered) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{wrongReason}, #{mastered})
mapper.select: SELECT q.subject as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM wrong_question w LEFT JOIN question q ON w.question_id = q.id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.subject ORDER BY count DESC
